segments.text:
Controlled financial-claim test. Some statements are deliberately incorrect or
lack evidence.

Nvidia reported revenue of 96.221 billion US dollars for fiscal Q2 2027.

Nvidia reported net income of 71.6256 billion US dollars for fiscal Q2 2027.

Nvidia reported diluted EPS of 2.46 US dollars for fiscal Q2 2027.

Nvidia reported revenue of 96.221 billion US dollars for fiscal Q4 2028.
